body:
## Pensieve 0.6.0

A review of the whole app, on phones and computers.

### Fixed
- **Back:** it now returns to where you came from — Today, a search, a link — and on a phone it first closes what's open (a dialog, a menu, an opened email), then goes back a screen, then to Today; it never drops you out of the app by surprise. Alt+← / → and the mouse's back buttons work on the computer; swipe from the edge on an iPhone.
- **Text on buttons and tabs** no longer runs off the screen on phones: long project names, chips, pickers, dialog buttons and tab strips all fit (strips fade where there is more to scroll).
- **AI work keeps going when you leave a screen**, and you can see it: "AI working" in the corner. A second tap never runs it twice. Closing the capture sheet while the AI thinks loses nothing.
- **Screens remember** their search, filters and what was open; a paper reopens instantly.
- **Sync:** the phone no longer shows its sync token to strangers while looking for your computer; changing networks no longer re-uploads everything; stuck pushes and half-dead connections after sleep fix themselves.
- **Voice:** dictation no longer gets stuck on "Transcribing…"; a recording interrupted by a call keeps what it caught.
- Plus about sixty smaller fixes: undo for Archive, milestone and task deletions; prices with decimals; no double-created pages or tasks; dates that reset while typing; the wrong file shown; Notion imports (nested numbered lists, columns, tables, properties, large exports, reading lists); BibTeX accents; monthly repeats on the 31st; reminders after a long weekend; and more.

### New
- **A reading list from Notion becomes papers:** a database with Authors / DOI / URL / arXiv columns has a "Rows → papers" button; each row goes into the paper library with its notes, tags and reading status.
- "AI working" indicator; undo and Restore for archived mail.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.0.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.0-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.0-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.0-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.0-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.0-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
